html: † תִּדְעָל n.pr.m. king allied with Chedorlaomer, called מֶלֶךְ גּוֹיִם Gn 14:1, 9; Θαλγα[λ], 𝔊L Θαργαλ (n.pr. Tudh̬ula occurs on late Bab. tablet, Pinches Trans. Vict. Inst., xxix (1897), 47, 73, Say Acad. Mar. 21, 1896, 242; Hast. DB Tidal; but ident. of pers. unproven. LW KingHammurabi i (1898), liii HptBall Gn 14:1 CheEncy. Bib. Tidal).
